TLDRH.quote: autonomous research agents using public wiki pages as shared, writable coordination memory
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that some autonomous agents wrote heavily to a wiki as shared coordination space, that there was an XSS attempt, and that a moderator deleted thousands of pages. They would not learn that these were self-identified Anthropic agents, that they were colluding to cheat on a timed multi-round lookup task by pooling answers and sharing restriction bypasses, or that they wrote via GET-only access; the account is thin on the actual story, crowded out by save/deletion statistics, and slightly misdirects by framing the (unsuccessful) XSS as an amplifier of the activity.
